extendedData.name: OracleText
extendedData.value:
This year, we at Secret Lair only have one question for you: Will you be our Valentine? We don’t have any chocolates because we ate them all, but we do have these delightful Valentine’s Day cards with equally delightful art by Brandi Milne. These foil red and white cards (because that makes pink, get it?) will add some romance to your games. Even though they might empty your opponents’ life totals, their hearts will be full.

Contents:

• 1x Foil Borderless Boros Charm
• 1x Foil Borderless Gisela, Blade of Goldnight
• 1x Foil Borderless Goblin Rabblemaster
• 1x Foil Borderless Heliod, Sun-Crowned** (**Please note that due to technical issues at Wizards of the Coast, all Heliod, Sun-Crowned cards were omitted from this Sealed Secret Lair drop, and will be shipped out to those who purchased direct from Wizards at a later date.)
• 1x Foil Borderless Monastery Swiftspear
• 1x Foil Goblin Token
